title: Inspect and extend: Channels and messages as typed records
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/chat.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve channel/chatmessage models, seeded data, and unread display.
problem: A channel is a named room and a message is one entry in its timeline. Read the typed models and seed fixtures before tracing how lists display them. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/chat.ts` and the related project files: src/chat.ts; src/data.ts; src/screens/ChannelsScreen.tsx.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to channel/chatmessage models, seeded data, and unread display.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Seed rows are local demo content and do not prove a server account exists.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A channel is a named room and a message is one entry in its timeline. Read the typed models and seed fixtures before tracing how lists display them.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/chat.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
